page.overview:
Who is Andressa?

Nolan (husband) Oliver Grayson (son) Mark Grayson (stepson) Unnamed † (father in-law) Unnamed † (mother in-law)

Andressa was a minor character in Invincible, debuting in Season 2. She hailed from the planet Thraxa and was their empress. She was married to the former Monarch of Thraxa and has a son, Oliver Grayson.

She is a vibrant cyan-blue insectoid creature resembling a mantis, with two multifaceted red eyes and a pair of antennae. Her arms are lined with long spines, and her hands have two fingers each. Her forelegs end with two toes.

As a Thraxan, Andressa lives quite a short life from a human point of view. At a young age, she was very wise and forgiving as is with most Thraxans as shown when she says, "Thraxans forgive and move on." She was always quick to fall in love, which is shown in her short relationship with Nolan (Omni-Man). She falls madly in love with him very quickly. She still misses Nolan even after he was taken by the other not-so-friendly Viltrumites, which is why in her dying moments she gave their son Oliver to Mark, so as to protect him from the evil Viltrum Empire, as well as to give him a place with a family to look after him.
